_doc: Per-fixture break-decision regression thresholds. Each entry pins the worst-case-acceptable metric observed at the cycle in which it was added + ~25-30% headroom. Future composer / shaper changes must keep their numbers at-or-below these. Loosening a threshold to chase a passing run is a regression in disguise — fix the change or revert.
_history: cycle 4 (2c): initial gate with text + text-advanced; word_match_rate was a loose byte-span heuristic.
cycle 5 (Track 1): re-baselined word_match_rate after source-text plumbing. The new metric is strict first/last-word equality; pre-cycle-5 baselines and thresholds were retired.

thresholds._note: word_match_rate_mean is 0.0: drop-cap segmentation differs between renderer (source text excludes drop cap) and pdftotext (sees the drop cap as the line's first word). Not a Q-20 calibration target; tracked separately.
